serializedLocalizedConversation.mainText:
Shanice: Hello! You made it!
Ecclesiasticalot FF: Don’t be so loud Shanice. We don’t want to summon unwanted company.
Shanice: Sure, sure.
You: You are coming too?
Ecclesiasticalot FF: Of course. I couldn’t possibly let you three go to such a dangerous place alone.
You: I hope you don’t mind him going with us {f_botName}?
Bot: I don’t. We already talked it through.
You: Talked it through? When?
Bot: A few seconds ago. We communicated through Bluetooth. It was refreshing, I didn’t have to wait for a slow human brain to process my words, create an answer and for vocal cords to say it.
Shanice: Come on {f_botName}, don’t act like a creepy toaster and talk with us! We don’t mind!
Bot: If you insist.
Shanice: And you too, Priestcan.
Ecclesiasticalot FF: She messaged me first.
Bot: Snitch.
You: Let’s go to the place already. We are wasting time.
Shanice: Alright. Geez. Let us have some bonding time.
